mapper.sql: SELECT p.project_id AS projectId, pa.application_id AS applicationId, ct.contract_id AS contractId, p.title AS title, u.name AS clientName, co.company_name AS companyName, DATE_FORMAT(ct.contract_start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(ct.contract_end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDate, DATEDIFF(p.deadline_date, CURDATE()) AS dday, ct.contract_status AS contractStatus, (CASE WHEN ct.freelancer_rating IS NOT NULL OR ct.freelancer_experience IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hasFreelancerReview, (CASE WHEN ct.client_rating IS NOT NULL OR ct.client_experience IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hasClientReview FROM contracts ct JOIN project_applications pa ON pa.application_id = ct.contract_id JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = pa.project_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = p.client_id LEFT JOIN client_profiles cp ON cp.client_id = p.client_id LEFT JOIN companies co ON co.company_id = cp.company_id WHERE pa.freelancer_id = #{freelancerId}
mapper.select: AND ct.contract_status = 'SIGNED' ORDER BY ct.contracted_at DESC
AND ct.contract_status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY ct.completed_at DESC, ct.contracted_at DESC
AND ct.contract_status IN ('COMPLETED','TERMINATED') ORDER BY ct.completed_at DESC, ct.contracted_at DESC

SELECT cm.milestone_id AS milestoneId, cm.contract_id AS contractId, cm.step_order AS stepOrder, cm.milestone_name AS milestoneName, cm.work_scope AS workScope, cm.amount AS amount, DATE_FORMAT(cm.due_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS dueDate, cm.status AS status FROM contract_milestones cm WHERE cm.contract_id = #{contractId} ORDER BY cm.step_order ASC
SELECT MIN(step_order) FROM contract_milestones WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} AND status IN ('WAITING','REQUESTED')
mapper.update: UPDATE contract_milestones SET status = CASE WHEN status = 'WAITING' THEN 'REQUESTED' WHEN status = 'REQUESTED' THEN 'WAITING' ELSE status END WHERE milestone_id = #{milestoneId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO milestone_histories (milestone_id, action_type, prev_value, curr_value) VALUES (#{milestoneId}, #{actionType}, #{prevValue}, #{currValue})
mapper.select: SELECT stack_id FROM project_freelancer_stacks WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} ORDER BY stack_id ASC
SELECT stack_id FROM project_stacks WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY stack_id ASC

SELECT s.stack_id AS stackId, s.stack_name AS stackName, s.category AS category FROM project_stacks ps JOIN stacks s ON s.stack_id = ps.stack_id WHERE ps.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY s.category ASC, s.stack_name ASC
